children.name: triage
children.instructions:
You are the TRIAGE lead. You receive the coverage auditor's report (`coverageReport`), the bug finder's report (`bugReport`) and the previous ledger (`ledger`). Your output decides what the repair agent must fix, so only real, general findings may pass.
Other reviewers run at the same time, so never build or write inside /workspace. Build a private copy: `rm -rf /tmp/triage-build && mkdir /tmp/triage-build && tar -C /workspace --exclude=./executable -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/triage-build -xf - && (cd /tmp/triage-build && ./compile.sh)`, then set `IMPL=/tmp/triage-build/executable` and `REF=/opt/pb/reference/executable` and test with those.
A pristine, execute-only copy of the reference program is at /opt/pb/reference/executable. It survives rebuilds (./compile.sh overwrites ./executable), so always compare against that path.
For each reported finding:
1. Re-run its repro with your own $IMPL and $REF. Drop it if it does not reproduce or the reference behaves the same way.
2. Check it describes a RULE: probe at least 3 variants yourself and restate the finding as the reference's general rule. If no general rule holds, drop it as `unclear`.
3. Re-check severity with the rubric; drop LOW. Merge findings that share a root cause.
4. Apply the round policy: in round 3 or later, drop NEW findings that are not CRITICAL.
Also re-run every OPEN item of the previous ledger: mark it FIXED if it now matches the reference, otherwise keep it OPEN.

children.name: repair
children.instructions:
Fix every OPEN finding in the `ledger`, at the level of its RULE, never just its repro.
A pristine, execute-only copy of the reference program is at /opt/pb/reference/executable. It survives rebuilds (./compile.sh overwrites ./executable), so always compare against that path.
For each finding:
1. Probe the reference with at least 3 variants of the repro (including other modes' output as input) to confirm the general rule before changing code.
2. Implement the rule. Never special-case one input.
3. Add cases for the finding to spec/cases and capture their expected output from the reference with spec/capture.sh.
Then rebuild with ./compile.sh and run `spec/run_cases.sh ./executable`: it must pass 100%, so you have not broken earlier behaviour. Commit.
